Title: H3D virtual screening cascade light
Description: Profiles compounds against the assays that drive the H3D Centre's malaria and tuberculosis programmes, covering whole-cell activity against Plasmodium falciparum and Mycobacterium tuberculosis plus cytotoxicity, solubility, permeability, microsomal stability and cytochrome inhibition. The original cascade was built with ZairaChem from a decade of in-house screening data at the University of Cape Town. This lighter reimplementation fits FLAML models over Ersilia Compound Embeddings and retains more than 95% of the full pipeline's reported performance at far lower computational cost.
Interpretation: Probabilities of activity in fourteen H3D cascade assays, with percentiles against a 200,000-molecule ChEMBL reference set.
